meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对科学数据进行探索性分析并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析科学数据集并发现异常
copy.tagline_en: Perform exploratory analysis on scientific data and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly analyze scientific datasets and detect anomalies

howto.what: 用户给出科学数据文件路径后，Claude 会自动识别文件类型，分析数据结构、内容与质量，计算统计摘要，识别缺失值和异常值，并生成 Markdown 报告，内含关键发现与后续建议。
howto.when: 当用户提供科学数据文件的路径，或要求探索、分析、总结某个数据文件，或询问数据质量与合适的分析方法时触发。

say.text: 分析一下 reads.fastq，告诉我序列数和质量得分情况。
say.note: 会生成报告，包含读长分布、GC含量等。

say.text: 这份 experiment_results.csv 有哪些缺失值和异常值？
say.note: 会检查缺失模式、重复项，并给出处理建议。

say.text: 看看 cells.nd2 图像的通道和尺寸信息。
say.note: 会提取维度、通道等元数据并做统计摘要。

howto.what_en: Given a path to a scientific data file, Claude detects the type, checks structure, content and quality, computes summary stats, spots missing values/outliers, and outputs a Markdown report with findings and next-step suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a scientific data file path, asks to explore/analyze/summarize a data file, or asks about data quality or suitable analysis methods.

say_en.text: Analyze reads.fastq and tell me the sequence count and quality scores.
say_en.note: Generates a report with read lengths, GC content, etc.

say_en.text: What missing values and outliers are in this experiment_results.csv?
say_en.note: Checks missingness, duplicates, and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Check the channels and dimensions in this cells.nd2 image.
say_en.note: Extracts metadata like dimensions, channels, calibration.
